notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. Its spline end is the Span Driver's (../900-ToolInterface/912-002_SpanDriver.scad), which it replaces in the claw. The page opens cut on its axis, through the access bore. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
